current_status.stage: Donepezil LAI (IVL3003) is the confirmed active CNS asset — Phase 1 completed with topline PK/PD results presented at AAN 2026, partnered with Chong Kun Dang. Note: an aripiprazole CNS asset is referenced in some secondary/aggregator sources under the code 'IVL3002', but InventageLab's own official pipeline page (checked Sept 2026) lists IVL3002 as a hair-loss (not aripiprazole) candidate partnered with Daewoong, and lists no active aripiprazole program — this could not be independently verified and is flagged as unresolved rather than logged as a finding.
current_status.partner: Chong Kun Dang (co-development/commercialization of IVL3003 donepezil LAI)
current_status.data_point: Phase 1 topline (AAN 2026, presented Apr 18 2026): plasma drug concentration stable >4 weeks vs. daily oral comparator; dose-proportional systemic exposure; acetylcholinesterase inhibition comparable to repeated oral donepezil (Aricept) dosing

finding_history.summary: InventageLab and Chong Kun Dang signed a contract to jointly develop and commercialize IVL3003, a once-monthly donepezil long-acting injectable for dementia, built on InventageLab's IVL-DrugFluidic platform. The partnership remains listed as active on InventageLab's official pipeline page as of this research pass.
IVL3003 Phase 1 trial in Alzheimer's disease patients (n=73), conducted via Nucleus Network in Australia under HREC approval, ran from May 30 2023 through completion on March 25 2026.

InventageLab presented Phase 1 topline results for two CNS long-acting injectable candidates as posters at the American Academy of Neurology (AAN) 2026 annual meeting: IVL3003 (donepezil, dementia) showed plasma concentrations stable beyond 4 weeks with dose-proportional PK and AChE inhibition comparable to repeated Aricept dosing; IVL3004 (drug/alcohol addiction) showed sustained target plasma concentration without initial burst release and a favorable safety profile, at ~20% lower drug dose than existing commercial products.
